{{Top|leg}}
'''D'ring'my''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and one of a dozen major independent [[Drug dealer|spice dealers]] at the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].

A skilled and charismatic businessbeing, he attracted clients from all the region of the [[Bajic_sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. His [[smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] contacts delivered to drop-points, charging 200 [[Galactic_Credit_Standard/Legends|credits]] per day, and asking a 5,000 bonus for early delivery.

D'ring'my was a [[Speciesism|speciesist]] and considered "younger" [[species/Legends|species]] as inferior, preferring to do business with [[Pre-Republic era|ancient and "evolved"]] cultures. He tended to be rather abrupt and unfriendly to the rest.
